title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1980-05-02
lineage: Mixed Source AUD: FOB (NAK 700 (set 1, John Hance) & AKG 1000E (set 2, Jim Wise))> Master Cassette (Sony TC-D5); Master Cassette (Nakamichi Dragon)> A/D Conversion via Sony R700> COAX to ZA2> Soundforge> MASTER CDR> EAC in Secure Mode> Soundforge> CD WAV>

ai_review.summary: Jerry’s raw, front‑center guitar powers a fiery first set while the recording is modestly clear but not pristine.
ai_review.review: The show shines thanks to Jerry Garcia’s wild, cranked‑up playing – highlights include a blistering Minglewood Blues opener, an raucous Loser, a killer Far From Me solo and a soaring close with The Music Never Stopped.  Recording quality is decent for an early‑80s download but could use a cleaner mix, especially in the second set which falls flat compared to the first.

ai_rating.rationale: Three consistent 4‑star reviews praise the performance (especially Jerry) and note only modest recording flaws, yielding a solid overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is a bit muddy; guitar sits forward and can be harsh. Reviewers say it could be cleaner but still listenable for an early‑80s download.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is high‑energy and raw, driven by Jerry’s aggressive lead work. The second set loses momentum and feels weaker in comparison.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Front‑and‑center, cranked‑up tone; raw, wild solos dominate the first set but fade on the second.
